formal.assumptions: First step resets. Setup constant, flow control enabled, CTS=1, write=0. Subsequent reset and BREAK arbitrary.
formal.initial_state: Unspecified state bits zero; explicit upstream initial assignments retained
formal.limitation: Bounded two-state CTS safety only. Serial-data behavior checked separately in simulations. Not unbounded, all-parameter or CDC proof.
formal.property: Continuously blocked active-low CTS keeps o_busy high after eight synchronizer warm-up clocks, including BREAK recovery

replay.scope: Same top-level reset/BREAK inputs, fixed blocked CTS, four-state Icarus; not identical internal initial state
